value.text: On Saturday morning a conference of representatives of the English, Irish, Scotch, and Welsh Rugby Unions took place at the Grand Hotel, Manchester, Mr. Carrick, of the Scotch Union, presiding. The English representative did not take part in the proceedings. The meeting resolved that all international matches should in future be played under rules aproved of by an International Committee, to be formed immediately, of which Mr. Gardner, of the Scotch Union, is appointed pro tempore secretary.
Settlement of the Dispute Between the English and Scottish Rugby Unions
An International Board for the settlement of all such questions that may arise in future was also unanimously resolved on.
